title: Contain Windows Startup agent process trees and handle verified installer deployment pauses.
changes: Contain agent trees when a new Windows per-user Startup supervisor launches; existing running supervisors require a fresh launch to use the new implementation.
Confirm an empty process group before acknowledging shutdown and preserve failure state when the helper cannot provide that confirmation.
Retry only verified installer deployment pauses within a monotonic budget, account for HTTP setup time and cancel stalled requests.
Verify Windows x64 and ARM64 lifecycle and installer regressions, including Unicode paths and clean bootstrap through the pairing boundary.
Preserve the published 0.2.222 CPU sampling and asynchronous update lock fixes. Legacy Scheduled Task migration remains separate work.
